```yaml
descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Loads all Azure AD groups, counts them by type, and summarizes the landscape.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read

skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load Groups
    detail: Retrieve all groups from Microsoft Graph.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All

  - id: count_by_group_type
    format: transform
    label: Count Groups by Type
    detail: Count the number of groups for each group type.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_groups.output }}"
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - Unified
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
        - Other

  - id: summarize_landscape
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Group Landscape
    detail: Generate a concise summary of the group landscape.
    settings:
      system: You are an Azure AD admin assistant.
      prompt: |
        Summarize the group landscape based on the following data:
        {{ count_by_group_type.output }}
      temperature: 0.7
      maxTokens: 200

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: |
      Weekly Group Inventory Summary:
      {{ summarize_landscape.output }}
    data:
      group_counts: "{{ count_by_group_type.output }}"
      summary: "{{ summarize_landscape.output }}"
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Non‑Compliant Models
  description: Identify the top non‑compliant device models from managed devices.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read

skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load Managed Devices
    detail: Retrieve managed devices from the Graph API.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All

  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count by Compliance State
    detail: Count devices by compliance state.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown

  - id: sort_by_last_sync
    format: transform
    label: Sort by Last Sync
    detail: Sort devices by last sync date ascending and take the oldest 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10

  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize
    detail: Generate a summary of the sorted device data.
    settings:
      system: "You are a helpful assistant summarizing device compliance data."
      prompt: "Summarize the following data: {{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}"
      temperature: 0.7
      maxTokens: 200

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      load_devices: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      count_by_compliance: "{{ count_by_compliance.output }}"
      sort_by_last_sync: "{{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}"
```

```yaml
name: Dormant Guest Accounts Summary
description: Loads guest users from Microsoft Graph and summarizes dormant ones using an LLM.
mode: read
steps:
  - name: Load Guest Users
    type: graph
    graph:
      endpoint: /users
      query: |
        $filter=userType eq 'Guest'
  - name: Identify Dormant Users
    type: filter
    filter:
      condition: |
        user.lastSignInDateTime lt addDays(utcNow(), -90)
  - name: Summarize Dormant Accounts
    type: llm
    llm:
      prompt: |
        Summarize the following dormant guest accounts:
        {data}
      model: gpt-4
```
